concepts.way: misconception: a = b copies the value of a into b
concepts.quote: a = 10, b = 10. The value of a goes into b.
concepts.why: The student says the value moves from a into b, which reverses Java assignment; a = b copies b into a, so a = 20 and b = 20.
The answer gives values but says nothing about what a variable is or how it holds values; its only reasoning is about which way assignment goes.
